objective: show the metric separates a known-faithful measurer from a known fixed-prior guesser, using real oracle data as the base clip population
data_source: 48 valid pre-impact velocity measurements from the full 3-session oracle batch run (oracle_batch_results.json)

faithful_remeasurer.description: oracle_base * alpha -- a hypothetical perfectly faithful measurer

fixed_prior_emitter.description: ~1 m/s regardless of base clip, ignores the scale entirely (5% noise, seed=0)

robustness_check: confirmed SFS~1/~0 separation holds across alpha in {0.5, 2} and 5 random seeds for the prior emitter (see project memory)
